testResults.name: focused-consent-tests
testResults.command: uv run --extra dev pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/thesis/activation/
testResults.result: 44 parametrized items pass: natural-language ambiguity is structurally impossible (no text parameter exists; NL strings rejected in every slot), confirmation must restate the proposal's exact bundle hash/environment/action, paper/shadow/live default disabled, revocation and expiry enforced through the GrantLedger, one-shot scope consumed on first validated request, and the gatekeeper client fails closed before contacting the endpoint on revoked/expired/mismatched/capability/test-failure inputs
